	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subarctic } add = -0.04 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = subtropical } add = -0.04 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = arctic } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = arid } add = -0.13 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = mediterranean } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon } add = -0.11 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_cold_steppe } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_hot_steppe } add = -0.12 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = cold_arid } add = -0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic } add = -0.1 }
	if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_savanna } add = -0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = jungle } add = -0.13 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_mixed_forest } add = -0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_coniferous_forest } add = -0.04 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_dry_forest } add = -0.12 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = woods } add = -0.05 }
	if = { limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } add = -0.06 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_high } add = 0.06 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_high } add = 0.03 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_low } add = -0.19 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_low } add = -0.36 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_soil_sand } add = -0.05 }
}

pp_land_potential_wine = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { climate = continental } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = oceanic } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = tropical } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_savanna } add = -0.33 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subarctic } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = subtropical } add = -0.11 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = arctic } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = arid } add = -0.15 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = mediterranean } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_cold_steppe } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_hot_steppe } add = -0.15 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = cold_arid } add = -0.09 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon } add = -0.2 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon } add = -0.08 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental } add = 0.13 }
	else_if = { limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic } add = -0.2 }
	if = { limit = { vegetation = forest } add = -0.08 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = jungle } add = -0.17 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_mixed_forest } add = -0.14 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_coniferous_forest } add = -0.14 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = desert } add = -0.22 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp } add = -0.11 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_dry_forest } add = -0.14 }
	else_if = { limit = { vegetation = woods } add = -0.17 }
	if = { limit = { topography = mountains } add = -0.09 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_high } add = 0.05 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_low } add = -0.11 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_low } add = -0.28 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_soil_clay } add = -0.06 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_soil_peat } add = -0.14 }
}
